field_principles.field_principles: Explain why each required field exists so readers can audit the evidence contract.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record each prerequisite and fail closed when a required input cannot be checked.
field_principles.run_date: Bind the receipt to the requested execution date.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Name the computation that produced the scientific evidence.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Separate an executed CPU comparison from a terminal blocked run.
field_principles.execution_venue: Limit every claim to the host venue that was measured.
field_principles.duration_s: Report total experiment wall time without implying sampler-only throughput.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Bind the run to every required source and predecessor artifact.
field_principles.rows: Provide a stable roster of all finite fixture and seed comparison units.
field_principles.fixture_rows: Record immutable finite targets and their hashes.
field_principles.seed_rows: Record domain-separated replay seeds for each comparison unit.
field_principles.random_draw_rows: Expose sealed random receipts shared by Python and Rust.
field_principles.proposal_rows: Compare each language's proposed state and proposal probabilities.
field_principles.accept_rows: Compare acceptance ratios, thresholds, and decisions exactly.
field_principles.chain_rows: Compare every retained state in stable order.
field_principles.normalization_rows: Test that target, proposal, and transition laws normalize.
field_principles.support_rows: Test positive proposal support over the complete finite state space.
field_principles.detailed_balance_rows: Test the finite corrected kernel against detailed balance.
field_principles.stationarity_rows: Test that the exact target law is stationary under the kernel.
field_principles.histogram_rows: Compare complete finite state histograms from matched receipts.
field_principles.mutation_rows: Show that a deliberate fault in each invariant is detected.
field_principles.benchmark_rows: Report matched host work only after exact parity passes.
field_principles.machine_metadata: Record the host and language toolchains needed to interpret timing.
field_principles.warmup_policy: State how warmup avoids charging startup effects to measured work.
field_principles.compile_time_excluded: State whether compilation is outside the timing interval.
field_principles.throughput_interval_rows: Report repeat-level throughput and confidence intervals.
field_principles.ess_rows: Report effective sample size and ESS per second for matched chains.
field_principles.exact_parity_score: Summarize exact equality across all preregistered parity cells.
field_principles.rust_multiscale_parity_score: Name the Rust port's exact parity result explicitly.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: Prevent a host comparison from becoming a hardware claim.
field_principles.random_seed: Publish the root seed for deterministic replay.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind the final artifact fields to one canonical digest.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name the first failed gate with its expected and observed values.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Prevent internal validation from being described as an independent oracle.
field_principles.verdict_class: Classify the evidence without overstating a blocked or partial run.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Give a terminal verdict that agrees with the evidence class.

gate_check_summary.expected_value: all preconditions and exact parity pass
gate_check_summary.observed_value: artifact initialized before toolchain and input checks
